## Should flag

The cat sat on the mat quietly. The dog ran across the yard swiftly. The bird flew over the tree gently. The fish swam under the boat slowly.

*(fiction)*

Variables were selected based on theory. Data analysis required careful review. Results matched earlier preliminary findings. Conclusions emerged from rigorous testing.

*(academic)*

We built the system for reliability. We tested it very thoroughly. We verified each component carefully. We deployed it last month.

*(business-memo)*

## Should not flag

The system is incredibly complex and sophisticated. It works. The results look promising.

*(technical-reference)*

Performance matters. We built it carefully. The implementation strategy was sound. Testing revealed no issues.

*(journalism)*

She walked through the quiet garden. The flowers were beautiful. Birds sang in the trees. Everything felt peaceful and serene.

*(fiction)*
